# `Q-12-23` — YAML-File Listing Contents Not Yet Supported

> A `contents:` entry names a YAML file. Quarto 2 does not yet read
> listing records from YAML files; the entry is skipped.

## What this means

Quarto 1 accepts a third kind of `contents:` entry alongside globs
and inline records: a path to a `.yml`/`.yaml` file holding a list of
listing records, read from disk at render time.

```yaml
# Q1 — not yet supported in Quarto 2
listing:
  contents:
    - items.yml
    - posts/*.qmd
```

Quarto 2 does not read listing records from YAML files yet. The
entry is skipped — it contributes no items — while the rest of
`contents:` (globs and inline records) resolves normally.

## Why this happens

The project was migrated from Quarto 1, or copied a `contents:` list
that pointed at a YAML file of records.

## How to fix

Move the records inline under `contents:` — each top-level YAML
sequence entry becomes one record:

```yaml
listing:
  contents:
    - title: Get started
      path: download.qmd
    - title: Learn more
      path: guide.qmd
    - posts/*.qmd
```

Support for reading `contents:` from an external YAML file is
planned for a later release.
